```{r}
library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(DT)

Dados_saude <- tibble::tibble(
  code_health_region = c(11001),
  name_health_region = c(
    "Vale do Jamari - RO"
  ),
  code_state = c(11),
  abbrev_state = c("RO"),
  name_state = c(
    "Rondônia"
  ),
  code_region = c(1),
  name_region = c(
    "Norte"
  ),
  year = c(2025),
  geometry = c(
    "POLYGON (...)"
  )
)

datatable(
  Dados_saude,
  options = list(
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    dom = "t",
    pageLength = 5,
    initComplete = JS("function(settings, json) {
      var table = this.api().table().container();
      $(table).find('td, th').css('background-color', 'white');
      $(table).css('background-color', 'white');
    }")
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
